operators.name: conv_transpose1d_forward

returns.shape: [batch, input_dim, output_length] where output_length = (length - 1)*stride - 2*padding + kernel_size + output_padding

semantics: Performs 1D transposed convolution (ConvTranspose1d) with bias=False as in reference.
Input is float32 CUDA tensor [B, C_in, L]; weight is float32 CUDA tensor [C_in, C_out, K] with C_in=C_out=input_dim.
Uses provided kernel_size, stride, padding, output_padding as integer scalars.
Output shape exactly matches reference: [B, C_out, L_out] with L_out = (L-1)*stride - 2*padding + kernel_size + output_padding.
No bias is added because reference bias=False; extension must not add any bias.
Supports non-contiguous input/weight via stride-aware access or explicit contiguous copy inside custom kernel; no assumption of row-major after transposition.

operators.name: ge_forward
semantics: Element-wise comparison input >= other, where other is a scalar float (0.0 in reference).
Returns a boolean CUDA tensor of the same shape as input.
Comparisons are performed elementwise with broadcasting: scalar is broadcast to all elements.
The operation is exactly torch.ge(input, other) with other=0.0.
Applies ConvTranspose1d with parameters: input_dim=256, output_dim=256, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1, bias=False.
Input shape [16, 256, 8192], output shape [16, 256, 16384], dtype float32, device cuda.
The convolution uses cuDNN internally; our custom op must replicate the same mathematical operation.
Output shape [16, 256, 16384], dtype bool, device cuda.
Result is True for non-negative values, False for negative values.
Returns the boolean tensor from step_002.
